correctness.rationale: The source graph, involution, unique eligible 1- or 2-vertex orbits and all cross-orbit adjacency have exact definitions; the orbit-barycenter map proves a simplicial homeomorphism with the geometric fixed realization. For n=1..18, recursive enumeration generates every partition once and both directions of every unit-transfer adjacency; all original invariant cliques are independently listed and compared to the orbit-complex faces. In every case, every face of dimension >=2 is eliminated by a verifiably free codimension-one face, leaving a graph. At n=18, the four explicitly recorded legal collapses give 15 vertices, 14 edges, two components, and one graph cycle, hence S1 disjoint point. All n<18 yield forests. Replaying verify.py against its actual embedded source regenerates the exhaustive results; no infinite extrapolation is claimed.

value.rationale: The canonical conjugation involution of the newly studied partition transfer graph has a natural geometric fixed space that is distinct from the graph-vertex fixed axis. The least n for which that fixed space acquires an essential loop is a motivated structural transition, not an arbitrary numerical slice; the complete exact calculation establishes a sharp cutoff and an integral homotopy classification at its boundary. This refines the existing 2026 nonequivariant homotopy theorem in a topologically meaningful, non-implied direction.
